_description: Formula-bearing point tools (Phase 6): endLine with a literal formula, endLine with a measurement-name formula (proving measurement-reactivity -- 'shoulder_length' is looked up from fixtures/measurements/sample.smis, not pre-resolved to a number before being passed through), normal, and alongLine. Every formula field is still a JSON string on the wire even when its value is a plain number, matching the architectural rule that formulas are never pre-resolved by the action layer itself.
